description: Use this for what smart money, Congress or politicians, insiders, funds, influencers or top traders are buying, selling, holding or saying, and where smart money is stacking up. The activity filter accepts buy (buying, adding, accumulating), sell (selling, reducing) or all. Category congress covers politicians, and the actor filter accepts names such as Pelosi or Berkshire. Omitting the ticker returns a bounded discovery preview; a ticker returns security research. Actor and activity filters precede the three-row cap, but underlying coverage remains bounded. Fund changes are reported holdings, influencer posts are commentary, trader positions are derivatives and government awards have no buy/sell direction. Each factual row carries its source link. Identical displayed rows are grouped; matchingStoredRows is not a distinct transaction count. This is not a market-wide convergence ranking.
name: get_smart_money
title: Check smart money activity
